entry_trigger: Only consider after official leadership clarity and regular-session price support with verified intraday volume and SPY relative strength.

target_and_stop_basis: No numeric target/stop or R:R asserted; ATR, gap and executable spread unverified. Invalidation on renewed low break or adverse official board action.
